card.name: Spots just before a word starting with n
card.fires_on: Marks a spot where the next piece is likely to begin with "no" or "n": the p in dys-p-nea, "non" before a hyphen, or a zero inside 100,000. Also fires on "the" or "and" before a noun in archery instructions.

modes.label: Inside dyspnea
modes.description: The letter p partway through the word dyspnea in lists of reaction symptoms.

modes.label: Non before hyphen
modes.description: The prefix non in non-painful, just before a hyphenated word.

modes.label: Linking words in bow-making text
modes.description: The words the or and in archery or arrow-making advice, before a noun.
modes.example: It is better to break them before you fix the fletchings<< and>> the points.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing "no" or "No" next.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to continue with a "no" sound, such as dys-p-nea or non-.
